title: Section 107 TPA — How a lease is made

content.overview: A lease from year to year, for more than a year, or reserving yearly rent, must be registered. Shorter leases may be oral plus possession.
content.study: An unregistered one-year-plus instrument cannot be used as a lease. It may still evidence a collateral fact. State registration amendments can tighten this.
